title: 118. Quantitative Relationships & Measurement: Average Growth Rates over Equal Intervals
description: A comprehensive mathematics curriculum progressing from foundational numeracy and core mathematical concepts to algebra, geometry, calculus, linear algebra, probability, statistics, discrete mathematics, optimization, mathematical foundations of AI, advanced pure mathematics, and emerging research methods.

questions.concept: Average Annual Growth Rate from Initial and Final Values
questions.learningObjective: Calculate the average annual growth rate over equal intervals from initial and final amounts.
questions.question: An investment grows from \(2{,}000\text{ yuan}\) to \(2{,}880\text{ yuan}\) over \(2\text{ years}\). What constant annual compound growth rate gives the same total growth?
questions.explanation: The annual factor is \(\sqrt{\frac{2{,}880}{2{,}000}}=1.2\), giving \(20\%\) per year. The alternative \(44\%\) is the total two-year growth, not an annual compound rate.
questions.hint: Find the total multiplicative change over the stated equal intervals.

questions.concept: Average Annual Growth Rate from Total Percentage Increase
questions.learningObjective: Determine the average annual growth rate when the total percentage increase over equal intervals is known.
questions.question: A quantity increases by a total of \(69\%\) over \(2\text{ years}\). What is the average annual growth rate?
questions.explanation: A total increase of \(69\%\) means the final value is \(1.69\) times the original value. Over \(2\) equal annual intervals, the average annual growth factor is \(\sqrt{1.69}=1.30\). Thus the average annual growth rate is \(1.30-1=0.30=30\%\). Option B incorrectly divides \(69\%\) by \(2\).
questions.hint: Ask which constant per-period factor reproduces the final amount.

questions.concept: Average Annual Growth Rate over Three Equal Intervals
questions.learningObjective: Calculate the average annual growth rate when the total growth factor over three years is known.
questions.question: A sum grows from \(1{,}000\text{ yuan}\) to \(1{,}331\text{ yuan}\) over \(3\text{ years}\). What is the average annual growth rate? Round to two decimal places.
questions.explanation: The total factor is \(\frac{1{,}331}{1{,}000}=1.331\). Its cube root is \(1.10\), giving an annual compound growth rate of \(10.00\%\). The alternative \(11.03\%\) divides the total percentage increase by three: \(\frac{33.1\%}{3}\approx 11.03\%\), which ignores compounding.
questions.hint: Distinguish an average growth factor from an arithmetic average of rates.

questions.concept: Average Annual Growth Rate from Population Data
questions.learningObjective: Calculate the average annual growth rate of a population over three equal intervals.
questions.question: A population grows from \(8{,}000\) to \(9{,}261\) over \(3\text{ years}\). What is the average annual growth rate?
questions.explanation: The annual factor is \(\sqrt[3]{\frac{9{,}261}{8{,}000}}=1.05\), so the annual compound rate is \(5\%\). Dividing the total increase by three instead gives \(\frac{9{,}261-8{,}000}{8{,}000}\times\frac{100\%}{3}\approx 5.25\%\), which ignores compounding.
questions.hint: Find the total multiplicative change over the stated equal intervals.

questions.concept: Average Annual Growth Rate from a Growth Multiple
questions.learningObjective: Determine the average annual growth rate when the final value is a given multiple of the original value.
questions.question: A quantity grows to \(1.4641\) times its original value over \(4\text{ years}\). What is the average annual growth rate?
questions.explanation: The equivalent annual factor is \(\sqrt[4]{1.4641}=1.10\), giving \(10\%\) per year. The alternative \(46.41\%\) is the total four-year increase, \((1.4641-1)\times 100\%\), rather than the annual compound rate.
questions.hint: Ask which constant per-period factor reproduces the final amount.

questions.concept: Final Value from an Average Annual Growth Rate
questions.learningObjective: Calculate the final value after several years given the average annual growth rate.
questions.question: An investment of \(5{,}000\text{ yuan}\) grows at an average annual rate of \(8\%\) for \(3\text{ years}\). What is its value after \(3\text{ years}\)?
questions.explanation: The average annual growth factor is \(1+0.08=1.08\). After \(3\text{ years}\), the value is \(5{,}000(1.08)^3=5{,}000\times 1.259712=6{,}298.56\text{ yuan}\). Option A incorrectly adds simple interest of \(5{,}000\times 0.08\times 3=1{,}200\).
questions.hint: Distinguish an average growth factor from an arithmetic average of rates.

questions.concept: Average Growth Rate from Initial and Final Values over Three Intervals
questions.learningObjective: Calculate the average growth rate per interval when the total growth over three intervals is known.
questions.question: A quantity grows from \(1{,}000\) to \(1{,}728\) over \(3\) equal intervals. What is the average growth rate per interval? Round to two decimal places.
questions.explanation: The total factor is \(\frac{1{,}728}{1{,}000}=1.728\), whose cube root is \(1.20\). The compound rate per interval is \(20.00\%\). The alternative \(24.27\%\) divides the total increase by three, \(\frac{72.8\%}{3}\approx 24.27\%\), rather than taking a cube root of the factor.
questions.hint: Find the total multiplicative change over the stated equal intervals.

questions.concept: Average Annual Growth Rate from Two-Year Population Data
questions.learningObjective: Calculate the average annual growth rate from initial and final populations over two years.
questions.question: A population increases from \(6{,}250\) to \(7{,}290\) over \(2\text{ years}\). What is the average annual growth rate?
questions.explanation: The total growth factor is \(\frac{7{,}290}{6{,}250}=1.1664\). Over \(2\) equal annual intervals, the average annual growth factor is \(\sqrt{1.1664}=1.08\). Thus the average annual growth rate is \(1.08-1=0.08=8\%\). Option B incorrectly uses the total growth as the annual rate.
questions.hint: Ask which constant per-period factor reproduces the final amount.

questions.concept: Overall Average Growth Rate from Two Different Growth Phases
questions.learningObjective: Determine the overall average annual growth rate when two different annual rates apply over equal sub-periods.
questions.question: An investment grows at an average annual rate of \(10\%\) for the first \(2\text{ years}\) and \(20\%\) for the next \(2\text{ years}\). What is the overall average annual growth rate over the \(4\text{ years}\)? Round to two decimal places.
questions.explanation: The total factor is \(1.10^2\times 1.20^2=1.7424\). The equivalent annual rate is \((\sqrt[4]{1.7424}-1)\times 100\%\approx 14.89\%\). The alternative \(15.00\%\) is the arithmetic average of the annual rates; it does not preserve the compounded total.
questions.hint: Distinguish an average growth factor from an arithmetic average of rates.

questions.concept: Total Percentage Increase from an Average Annual Growth Rate
questions.learningObjective: Calculate the total percentage increase over two years from a given average annual growth rate.
questions.question: An investment grows at an average annual rate of \(12\%\) for \(2\text{ years}\). What is the total percentage increase over the \(2\text{ years}\)?
questions.explanation: The average annual growth factor is \(1+0.12=1.12\). Over \(2\text{ years}\), the total growth factor is \((1.12)^2=1.2544\). The total percentage increase is \(1.2544-1=0.2544=25.44\%\). Option B incorrectly adds \(12\%+12\%=24\%\).
questions.hint: Find the total multiplicative change over the stated equal intervals.
